card.name: Target names before antibody words
card.fires_on: The last piece of an antibody target name such as CD38, CD20, EGFR, GD2 or ErbB2, right before the word antibody or monoclonal. Also fires on small words just before an antibody description.

modes.label: Target name ending
modes.description: Final piece of a target label after anti- or in a target-binding antibody phrase.

modes.label: Linking word before antibody
modes.description: A small word or comma that comes just before a drug is described as an antibody.

card.writes: It pushes toward the start of the word monoclonal (Mon, monoc, mono), which usually follows an antibody target name.
card.plain: It spots the point where an antibody's target has just been named and the word monoclonal is likely to come next.
